verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own pages claim 4K path-tracing, DLSS Multi Frame Generation, and Reflex low-latency gaming performance, and Tom's Hardware's independent review confirms it as the 'fastest GPU around' with strong AI/ray-tracing performance; the HN geomean benchmark also shows ~1.42x uplift vs 4090. However, independent testing raises real caveats: MFG's rendered-frame boost doesn't match native high-refresh input sampling, driver issues in some games, thermal concerns on the Founders Edition, and unresolved 12VHPWR connector melting reports under high loads, none of which are gaming-benchmark specific but affect real-world 4K gaming reliability. missing for 10: dedicated native 4K high-refresh game benchmark suite (fps numbers per title) rather than general compute benchmarks, and resolution of power-connector/thermal reliability concerns.
